what_happened: Research confirmed the full gate-lock mechanism can be built from existing task-lock.sh primitives (acquire_named_mutex, commit-acquire/release pattern, resolve_session_pid, session_liveness) with zero new concurrency primitives -- only two new CLI subcommands and two call-site wirings.

The research report settled the lease-vs-advisory question with a concrete reuse surface (acquire_named_mutex plus a commit-acquire-shaped CLI pair) and exact call sites, so planning needed no re-derivation of the design -- only grounding reads to confirm it. Planning time went to integration detail rather than design.

Four integration constraints were found by plan-time source reads that the research report did not surface, each of which would have produced a broken or self-defeating implementation if planned from the report alone: the source-store task-lock.sh copy exits 1 under deploy-root-guard.sh so both call sites must invoke the deployed copy; run-all.sh already installs a per-branch EXIT trap on each of its two execution paths, which would silently clobber a top-level gate-lock release trap and leak the mutex for a full staleness window; a --only-narrowed run must skip the lock or suite narrowing (the sanctioned sub-full tier discharge mechanism) would be taxed with a full-battery wait; and the new fixture suite must clear inherited RUN_ALL_NESTED/GATE_MUTEX_HELD or its unnested cases go vacuous when run under an outer battery. All four are now recorded in the plan's Research Integration section.

First draft of verify-deploy.sh's gate8_run() gate-lock bracket checked VERIFY_DEPLOY_NESTED directly, but that variable is unconditionally exported near the top of verify-deploy.sh (its own self-nesting guard) long before gate8_run() runs, so the check always read 1 and gate8_run()'s own acquire was always skipped -- confirmed live via a real --only-gate 8 run showing run-all.sh itself (not verify-deploy.sh) as the mutex owner. Fixed by capturing VERIFY_DEPLOY_WAS_NESTED_AT_ENTRY before the unconditional export, mirroring tests/run-all.sh's own RUN_ALL_WAS_NESTED_AT_ENTRY pattern.
